name: ET: Legacy
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: ET: Legacy, the open-source server for Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory, with the original game's files and Omni-bot. Settings are in etmain/etl_server.cfg.

config.files: {"etmain/etl_server.cfg": {"parser": "file", "find": {"set sv_hostname ": "set sv_hostname \"{{server.build.env.SERVER_NAME}}\"", "set sv_maxclients ": "set sv_maxclients \"{{server.build.env.MAX_PLAYERS}}\"", "set g_password ": "set g_password \"{{server.build.env.SERVER_PASSWORD}}\"", "set rconpassword ": "set rconpassword \"{{server.build.env.RCON_PASSWORD}}\""}}, "etmain/legacy.cfg": {"parser": "file", "find": {"set omnibot_enable ": "set omnibot_enable \"{{server.build.env.OMNIBOT}}\""}}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ET: Legacy. Downloads the ET: Legacy server for the node's CPU from
# etlegacy.com, checked against the SHA-256 the site lists, and the original
# Enemy Territory game files (pak0-2.pk3) from ET: Legacy's mirror, checked
# against their known checksums. Server configs, Lua scripts, maps and the
# mod's settings are never touched once they exist.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
site=https://www.etlegacy.com
ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$@"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) arch=x86_64 ;;
aarch64) arch=aarch64 ;;
*) fail "ET: Legacy has no server for $(uname -m)." ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
want="${want#v}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    page=$(get "$site/download" | tr -s ' \t\r\n' ' ') || fail "etlegacy.com can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    ver=$(grep -oE "etlegacy-v[0-9][0-9.]*-$arch\.tar\.gz" <<<"$page" | head -n 1 | sed -E 's/^etlegacy-v(.*)-[^-]*\.tar\.gz$/\1/') || true
    [ -n "$ver" ] || fail "etlegacy.com doesn't list a Linux $arch download right now. Reinstall to try again later."
else
    list=$(get "$site/download/release/list" | tr -s ' \t\r\n' ' ') || fail "etlegacy.com can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    id=$(grep -oE "/download/release/[0-9]+\"> ?<span class=\"dl-release-version[^\"]*\">${want//./\\.}<" <<<"$list" | head -n 1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | head -n 1) || true
    [ -n "$id" ] || fail "ET: Legacy has no release $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 2.86.2."
    page=$(get "$site/download/release/$id" | tr -s ' \t\r\n' ' ') || fail "etlegacy.com can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    ver=$want
fi
asset="etlegacy-v$ver-$arch.tar.gz"
file=$(grep -oE "href=\"$site/download/file/[0-9]+\"[^>]*title=\"${asset//./\\.}\"" <<<"$page" | head -n 1 | grep -oE '/file/[0-9]+' | cut -d/ -f3) || true
sum=$(grep -oE "${asset//./\\.} · .{0,200}SHA-256</dt> <dd[^>]*>[0-9a-f]{64}" <<<"$page" | head -n 1 | grep -oE '[0-9a-f]{64}$') || true
[ -n "$file" ] && [ -n "$sum" ] || fail "ET: Legacy $ver has no Linux $arch download."

build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

if [ "$(cat .raptor-etl 2>/dev/null)" = "$sum" ] && [ -x etlded ]; then
    echo "ET: Legacy $ver is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading ET: Legacy $ver ($arch)"
    get -o "$build/etl.tar.gz" "$site/download/file/$file"
    [ "$(sha256sum "$build/etl.tar.gz" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || fail "The download didn't match etlegacy.com's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xzf "$build/etl.tar.gz" -C "$build"
    new="$build/etlegacy-v$ver-$arch"
    [ -x "$new/etlded.$arch" ] || fail "The download has no etlded.$arch in it."
    mkdir -p legacy etmain
    # The mod's code is replaced (an older legacy_v*.pk3 left behind would
    # clash); its settings and scripts are only added where missing.
    rm -f legacy/legacy_v*.pk3 legacy/*.so
    cp -an "$new/legacy/." legacy/
    cp -af "$new/legacy/omni-bot/." legacy/omni-bot/ 2>/dev/null || true
    cp -an "$new/etmain/." etmain/
    cp -f "$new/etlded.$arch" etlded.new
    chmod +x etlded.new
    mv -f etlded.new etlded
    echo "$sum" > .raptor-etl
fi

# The original game's files, which ET: Legacy needs and can't ship itself.
while read -r pak psum; do
    if [ -f "etmain/$pak" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "etmain/$pak" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$psum" ]; then continue; fi
    echo "Downloading Enemy Territory's $pak"
    get -o "$build/$pak" "https://mirror.etlegacy.com/etmain/$pak" || fail "ET: Legacy's mirror can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    [ "$(sha256sum "$build/$pak" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$psum" ] || fail "$pak didn't match its known checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    mv -f "$build/$pak" "etmain/$pak"
done <<'PAKS'
pak0.pk3 712966b20e06523fe81419516500e499c86b2b4fec823856ddbd333fcb3d26e5
pak1.pk3 5610fd749024405b4425a7ce6397e58187b941d22092ef11d4844b427df53e5d
pak2.pk3 a48ab749a1a12ab4d9137286b1f23d642c29da59845b2bafc8f64e052cf06f3e
PAKS
mkdir -p .etlegacy
echo "Installed ET: Legacy $ver."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The ET: Legacy release to install, such as 2.86.2, or latest.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name in the server browser, up to 26 characters without colour codes.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The player slots, private slots included.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: A password players need to join. Empty lets anyone join.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The remote console password. Empty turns the remote console off.

variables.name: Omni-bot
variables.description: Fill empty slots with Omni-bot's bots.

variables.name: Config file
variables.description: The server config in etmain that runs at start.
